setup_language_modeling_task: setup a fairseq language modeling task by loading dictionaries and configuring target types
load_lm_dataset: load a language modeling dataset split like train or valid from indexed data
build_lm_model: build a language model for the fairseq language modeling task and validate supported targets
run_lm_inference: run inference with the language modeling task using prefix tokens and a generator
create_lm_eval_dataloader: create a dataloader for evaluating a language model with optional context window support
